llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: The short marketplace-style description is less complete than the full documentation, but the README and SKILL.md disclose recovery plans, hotels, lounges, and itinerary analysis, so this is a documentation-quality note rather than a Review-level concern.
[SQP-2] expected: Travel itinerary and commitment details are sent to Aerobase for recovery and itinerary analysis; this is sensitive but directly tied to the advertised feature and explicitly reflected in the documented API examples.
[SQP-2] expected: The Python CLI posts only user-supplied travel fields to matching Aerobase endpoints and does not collect unrelated local data; lack of an extra consent prompt is worth user guidance but does not make the skill suspicious.
llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sharing the travel details you ask the skill to analyze with Aerobase. Keep AEROBASE_API_KEY secret, rotate it if exposed, and avoid including confidential meeting names, health details, passport data, or sensitive business context unless you trust Aerobase to process it.
